name: Council of Verdure
source:
In the aftermath of a radioactive superbloom, dangerous mutated plants have thrown the world into a post-apocalyptic state. The Machinist Faction and Mage Faction do everything they can to save what’s left - but will their separate efforts ever be enough? 

See the world from two different perspectives. 

Play as Daniella Leighton, a Knight Mage of the Third Luminosity Regiment with the Mage Faction. See the missions that take Knight Mages where no one else can go and watch how magic could shape lives.

Or, play as Fabian Dimitrov, a researcher of Plant Pathology and Infectious Disease with the Machinist faction. See first hand the effects of the plants and try to unravel what no one else can. 

Make choices, ignite fate’s strings by finding ways to love, go with or against the path you chose. 

[From [url=https://afuera.itch.io/council-of-verdure]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
放射性超级花爆发后，危险的变异植物将世界拖入后末日状态。机械师派系与法师派系竭尽所能拯救残存的一切，但他们各自的努力真的足够吗？

从两种不同视角观察这个世界。

扮演法师派系第三光明军团的骑士法师丹妮拉·莱顿，跟随骑士法师执行那些无人能够涉足的任务，见证魔法如何塑造生活。

或者扮演机械师派系的植物病理学与传染病研究员法比安·季米特洛夫，亲眼观察变异植物造成的影响，尝试解开无人能够解开的谜团。

做出选择，通过寻找爱的方式点燃命运之弦，顺着或逆着你选择的道路前进。

[来自[url=https://afuera.itch.io/council-of-verdure]itch.io[/url]]
